spindle.observe.AnswerSource.description: What answered one external cause of a served command. `world`: the decision table of the last reset's world. `file`: the decisions file. `default`: the default branch `--answer-default` takes. `unanswered`: nothing did, and the command answered `501`.
spindle.observe.AnswerSource.title: AnswerSource

spindle.observe.Binding.description: One binding of the system. A periodic binding fires a command of `to` on a schedule and has no `from` and no `event`; an event binding carries `event` from `from` to a command of `to`.

command.description: The qualified name of the command the binding issues.

event.description: The qualified name of the event carried; absent for a periodic binding.

from.description: The component that publishes the event; absent for a periodic binding.

to.description: The component that accepts the command.

spindle.observe.Binding.title: Binding

spindle.observe.Catalogue.description: The answer of `GET /api/catalogue?component=`, every counter the runtime derives for one component from the compiled specification.
spindle.observe.Catalogue.title: Catalogue

spindle.observe.Component.description: One component of the system, with the domains it owns and what it accepts and serves.

commands.description: The qualified names of the commands the component accepts.

domains.description: The qualified names of the domains the component owns.

views.description: The qualified names of the views the component serves.

spindle.observe.Component.title: Component

spindle.observe.Counter.description: One counter of the catalogue, by its dotted name, such as `command.rally.table.Tick.served`.
spindle.observe.Counter.title: Counter

spindle.observe.CounterValue.description: The cumulative value of one counter of the catalogue.
spindle.observe.CounterValue.title: CounterValue

spindle.observe.DeployedInstance.description: One instance of a component, where it was placed, what it requested and its state.

started_at.description: When the instance was launched; absent until it runs.

spindle.observe.DeployedInstance.title: DeployedInstance

spindle.observe.Deployment.description: The answer of `GET /api/deployment`, the system as deployed.

system.description: The system identifier of the deployed specification.

spindle.observe.Deployment.title: Deployment

spindle.observe.EdgeKind.description: What one edge of the topology carries. `routes`: the ingress hands a request to a command or view. `contains`: a specification holds a domain, a domain a command, view or event. `asks`: a command asks an external cause. `emits`: a command's outcome emits an event. `carries`: an event travels a binding. `invokes`: a binding invokes a command, also one of another specification behind the same ingress.
spindle.observe.EdgeKind.title: EdgeKind

spindle.observe.EdgeTraffic.description: The live numbers of one edge since the run started, read from the counters `GET /__spindle/metrics` exposes and the ring `GET /__spindle/requests` holds.

count.description: Requests a `routes` edge handed on, events an `emits` edge emitted, envelopes a `carries` edge sent, commands an `invokes` edge invoked, questions an `asks` edge asked.

latest.description: For a `routes` edge, the sequences of its latest requests still in the ring, newest first, at most 5; each names a record of `GET /__spindle/requests`.

sources.description: For an `asks` edge, the count per answer source; empty for every other kind.

statuses.description: For a `routes` edge, the count per status class; empty for every other kind.

spindle.observe.EdgeTraffic.title: EdgeTraffic

spindle.observe.ExternalAnswer.description: One external cause a served command asked about, and what answered it.

holds.description: Whether the cause holds; absent when nothing answered it.

outcome.description: The outcome whose cause was asked about, as the command declares it.

spindle.observe.ExternalAnswer.title: ExternalAnswer

spindle.observe.Histogram.description: The cumulative buckets of one histogram of the catalogue. `bounds` are the inclusive upper bounds of the buckets in ascending order; `counts` has one entry per bound and one more for the values above the last bound.
spindle.observe.Histogram.title: Histogram

spindle.observe.MetricFamilies.description: Every metric family a served run exposes when it observes its ingress.
spindle.observe.MetricFamilies.title: MetricFamilies

spindle.observe.MetricFamily.description: One metric family `GET /__spindle/metrics` exposes in the Prometheus text format, by its name, type and label names. The exposition's `# HELP` line is `summary`.

labels.description: The label names every sample of the family carries, in order.

spindle.observe.MetricFamily.title: MetricFamily

spindle.observe.MetricKind.description: The Prometheus type of a metric family.
spindle.observe.MetricKind.title: MetricKind

spindle.observe.NodeKind.description: What one node of the topology stands for. `ingress`: the run's router, one per listener. `specification`: one loaded specification. `domain`: a domain of a specification. `command`, `view`, `event`: one declared in a domain. `external`: one external cause of a command's outcome. `binding`: one event or periodic binding, the channel an event travels.
spindle.observe.NodeKind.title: NodeKind

spindle.observe.OperationKind.description: What a routed request was for.
spindle.observe.OperationKind.title: OperationKind

spindle.observe.Payload.description: An event payload as JSON text, truncated to at most 1 KiB.
spindle.observe.Payload.title: Payload

spindle.observe.RecentAnswer.description: One command the instance executed, its outcome and the events it appended.

payload.description: The payload of the first event appended, if any.

spindle.observe.RecentAnswer.title: RecentAnswer

spindle.observe.RequestClass.description: How a served run answered one request. `served`: the model answered it, with any outcome the command declares, or the view's rows. `refused`: the ingress or ESS's standard refusal answered it `4xx` before the model did, other than `not-granted`. `not-granted`: `403` "not granted", no grant admits the actor. `not-served`: `501`, the operation is one this ingress cannot route, the kernel does not run or the host does not read, or an external cause nothing answered. `failed`: any other `5xx`. `unrouted`: no route has the path, or not under that method.
spindle.observe.RequestClass.title: RequestClass

spindle.observe.RequestLog.description: The answer of `GET /__spindle/requests`: the totals since the run started and the last requests the ring holds, newest first, those of the classes `?class=` names where it is given.

capacity.description: How many requests the ring holds at most.

format.description: Always `spindle-requests/1`; a reader refuses any other.

recorded.description: Every request recorded since the run started, kept or dropped by the ring.

spindle.observe.RequestLog.title: RequestLog

spindle.observe.RequestRecord.description: One request a served run answered, as `GET /__spindle/requests` lists it. Requests under `/__spindle/` are not recorded.

at.description: When the request's head was read.

duration_us.description: From the request's head read to its answer handed back, in microseconds.

events.description: The qualified names of the events the command published, in order.

externals.description: The external causes the command asked about, in the order asked.

operation.description: The qualified command or view the route is bound to, or the console route as `GET /api/model`; absent for an unrouted request.

outcome.description: The outcome the model selected, for a command it answered.

path.description: The request's path, without the query string.

reason.description: The `refused` text of the answer, as the caller received it, for every class but `served`.

route.description: The route template the path resolved to; absent for an unrouted request.

sequence.description: Monotonic per run, starting at 0; a gap in a list is a request the ring dropped.

spindle.observe.RequestRecord.title: RequestRecord

spindle.observe.RequestTotals.description: The requests a served run answered since it started, per class; requests under `/__spindle/` are not counted. Enough for a one-line banner.
spindle.observe.RequestTotals.title: RequestTotals

spindle.observe.ResourceReading.description: What the instance costs the host. A share is the reading against the instance's request: `cpu_share` is CPU seconds over wall seconds times requested vCPUs, `memory_share` is memory over requested MiB. An instance without a limit has no share.
spindle.observe.ResourceReading.title: ResourceReading

spindle.observe.Sample.description: One `sample` message of `GET /api/stream`: the cumulative counters of one instance at one instant. A lost sample is harmless, because the next one carries every total again.

dropped_frames.description: Samples the instance dropped since launch because the control process was slow or gone.

period_ms.description: The sampling period the instance runs with, in milliseconds.

recent.description: The last command answers of the instance, newest first.

spindle.observe.Sample.title: Sample

spindle.observe.SourceCount.description: How many times one source answered the external cause an `asks` edge leads to.
spindle.observe.SourceCount.title: SourceCount

spindle.observe.StateChange.description: One `state` message of `GET /api/stream`, an instance moving from one state to another.
spindle.observe.StateChange.title: StateChange

spindle.observe.StatusCount.description: How many requests of one status class an edge carried since the run started.
spindle.observe.StatusCount.title: StatusCount

spindle.observe.Topology.description: The answer of `GET /__spindle/topology`: the graph of every specification the ingress serves, from the ingress down to the bindings, with the live numbers of each edge.

at.description: When the live numbers were read.

format.description: Always `spindle-topology/1`; a reader refuses any other.

specifications.description: The system identifiers of the specifications served, in the order loaded.

spindle.observe.Topology.title: Topology

spindle.observe.TopologyEdge.description: One edge of the topology, from one node to another, with its live numbers.

from.description: The `id` of the node it leaves.

to.description: The `id` of the node it reaches.

traffic.description: Absent for a `contains` edge, which carries nothing.

spindle.observe.TopologyEdge.title: TopologyEdge

spindle.observe.TopologyNode.description: One node of the topology, derived from the loaded specifications, never authored.

id.description: Unique in the answer: `ingress`, the specification's system identifier, or the qualified name, prefixed by the kind and, for an external cause, the command and outcome, such as `external:tasks.ledger.Settle/settled`.

name.description: The name as the specification writes it.

specification.description: The system identifier of the specification it belongs to; absent for the ingress.

spindle.observe.TopologyNode.title: TopologyNode
